ColumnsSection.description: How the concepts are written in the source file.

encoding.description: Text encoding of the file, as Python names it, e.g. 'utf-8'.
encoding.title: Encoding

header_label_separator.description:
Splits a header into concept id and label at its first occurrence; a header
without it is all id. Null if headers carry no labels.
header_label_separator.title: Header Label Separator

value_label_separator.description:
Splits a coded value into code and label at its first occurrence. Null if
coded values carry no labels.
value_label_separator.title: Value Label Separator

missing_values.description: Measure texts that mean "no value"; such an observation is invalid.
missing_values.title: Missing Values

unmapped.description:
Columns expected in the file but not declared in structure: loaded with the
raw data, never mapped to canonical data, and not reported as unexpected.
unmapped.title: Unmapped

optional.description:
Declared concepts whose column may be absent: a warning instead of an error.
Every other declared concept is a required column.
optional.title: Optional

Concept.description: An SDMX concept: a column of the source file.

id.description:
Concept id, the code part of the column header (the part before the header
label separator).
id.title: Id

coded.description:
True if values are written as code and label, split at the first value label
separator; false if the value is taken whole (free text).

id.description: Identifier in snake_case, used in provenance and log lines.
id.title: Id

description.description: What the data is: the report's "About the data" paragraph.
description.title: Description

attribution.description: Source credit, shown in the chart caption and the report.
attribution.title: Attribution

data_dir.description:
Default data directory. A relative path is resolved against the working
directory when the command runs; '~' and '$' are not expanded.
data_dir.title: Data Dir

Dimension.description: A dimension of the series key.

id.description:
Concept id, the code part of the column header (the part before the header
label separator).
id.title: Id

coded.description:
True if values are written as code and label, split at the first value label
separator; false if the value is taken whole (free text).
coded.title: Coded

column.description: Name of its column in the canonical observations table.
column.title: Column

Measure.description: The concept that holds the observation value.

precision.description:
Total significant digits of the stored decimal value (at most 15, what an
exact rate allows).
precision.title: Precision

scale.description: Digits after the decimal point of the stored value (at most precision).
scale.title: Scale

unit_multiplier.description:
Coded series attribute whose code is the power of ten the published value is
multiplied by; null if values are stored as published.
unit_multiplier.title: Unit Multiplier

Measure.title: Measure

MetadataConcepts.description: Which concept fills each SeriesMetadata field.

ref_area.description: Coded dimension whose code is ref_area and whose label is ref_area_name.
ref_area.title: Ref Area

frequency.description: Dimension whose code is the frequency.
frequency.title: Frequency

title.description: Series attribute that holds the title.
title.title: Title

unit.description: Series attribute that holds the unit of measure; null if there is none.
unit.title: Unit

decimals.description: Series attribute that holds the display decimals; null if there is none.
decimals.title: Decimals

MetadataConcepts.title: MetadataConcepts

ObservationAttribute.description: An attribute that can change from one observation to the next.

id.description:
Concept id, the code part of the column header (the part before the header
label separator).
id.title: Id

coded.description:
True if values are written as code and label, split at the first value label
separator; false if the value is taken whole (free text).
coded.title: Coded

keep_as.description:
Name of its column in the canonical observations table; null if it stays in
the raw data only, read for checks.
keep_as.title: Keep As

invalid_codes.description: Codes that make an observation invalid whatever its value.
invalid_codes.title: Invalid Codes

ObservationAttribute.title: ObservationAttribute

metadata_fields.description: SeriesMetadata fields added to each summary row, in column order.
metadata_fields.title: Metadata Fields

RuleSpec.description: One data-quality rule to run: which one, how serious, with what parameters.

name.description: Name under which the rule is registered.
name.title: Name

enabled.description: False switches the rule off and keeps its settings.
enabled.title: Enabled

params.description: The rule's parameters, checked by the rule itself.
params.title: Params

RuleSpec.title: RuleSpec

lookback_months.description: Calendar months between a series' latest valid date and its target date.
lookback_months.title: Lookback Months

stale_latest_days.description:
A latest observation older than this many days before the dataset's latest
date is flagged STALE_LATEST.
stale_latest_days.title: Stale Latest Days

stale_prior_days.description:
A prior observation older than this many days before the target date is
flagged STALE_PRIOR.
stale_prior_days.title: Stale Prior Days

SourceSection.description: Where the source file is found and how it is downloaded.

discovery_url.description: Page whose links are searched for file_name.
discovery_url.title: Discovery Url

file_name.description: Exact last path segment of the link to pick; also the cached file's name.
file_name.title: File Name

fallback_url.description:
Download URL used when the page is unreachable or has no matching link. It
must end in file_name.
fallback_url.title: Fallback Url

cache_ttl_hours.description: How long a cached copy counts as fresh, in hours. 0 always revalidates.
cache_ttl_hours.title: Cache Ttl Hours

max_attempts.description: HTTP attempts per download, the first one included.
max_attempts.title: Max Attempts

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed to open a connection, in seconds.
connect_timeout_seconds.title: Connect Timeout Seconds

read_timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed between two received chunks, in seconds.
read_timeout_seconds.title: Read Timeout Seconds

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the series key, in key order.

series_attributes.description: Attributes constant within a series; they become series metadata.
series_attributes.title: Series Attributes

series_metadata.description: The concept bound to each SeriesMetadata field.

selection.description:
One code for each dimension other than the reference area, matched on the
code, e.g. a frequency dimension fixed to its daily code.

month and day.

structure.description: The source's concepts and their roles.

columns.description: How the concepts are written in the file.
